types.description: S202M-C6 miniature circuit breaker, two poles, C characteristic, 6 A

modelingNotes: S1 exact order table identifies S202M-C6, 2 poles, C characteristic, rated current 6 A. IEC/EN 60898-1: 400 V AC, 50/60 Hz, Icn 10 kA; C tripping reference temperature 30 degrees C. IEC/EN 60947-2 separately lists 440 V AC and Icu 15 kA. No installation voltage is assigned.

Numeric markings 1/2 and 3/4 follow the visually inspected S202 family diagram in the same catalog; applicability to S202M is a family inference. No phase or neutral assignment is made. Supply direction is optional.
Two breaker contact functions use the diagram's open-state convention and are mechanically ganged. Neither contacts nor mechanical metadata create fixed conductive links or simulate protection.
Wire and busbar accommodation is represented by shared connections on each existing named terminal. Optional auxiliary contacts and releases are separate accessories, not terminals of this order.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four manufacturer-numbered main terminals of the basic two-pole breaker: 1, 2, 3, 4. Wire/busbar accommodation belongs to these same terminal nodes. No supplied PE, shield, neutral-specific, auxiliary, release or communication connection. Separately fitted accessories require their own models.
